title: Scalar core of the D exchange-violation lower bound
statement: For real w, W_a, W_b, q_aa, q_bb, q_ab with 0<w<W_a, W_b>0, q_aa>=0, q_bb>=0, q_bb<=q_aa, and 0<=q_delta=q_aa+q_bb-2q_ab<=1/W_a+1/W_b, define alpha=wW_a/(W_a-w), beta=wW_b/(W_b+w), and E=alpha q_aa-beta q_bb-alpha beta(q_aa q_bb-q_ab^2). Then E>=alpha beta(q_delta^2+(q_aa-q_bb)^2)/4, hence E>=alpha beta q_delta^2/4, and q_delta>0 implies E>0.
assumptions: 0 < source atom weight < source cell mass

proof_location.section: D5. Exchange stability implies strict D-Voronoi geometry

role: machine-checked real-arithmetic bridge inside the finite D exchange theorem
warning: This formal proof starts after the matrix/determinant reduction and stops before the logarithm, distinct-centroid, singleton, duplicate-atom, and full Voronoi arguments. Those layers are now machine-checked separately on D-EXCHANGE-IMPLIES-VORONOI; this node remains the scalar lemma they rest on.
